canonical_title: Fire protection of structure, controls, and other parts.

versions.title_at_revision: Fire protection of structure, controls, and other parts.
versions.text:
Each part of the structure, controls, and the rotor mechanism, and other parts essential to controlled landing and (for category A) flight that would be affected by powerplant fires must be isolated under Sec. 29.1191, or must be--
(a) For category A rotorcraft, fireproof; and
(b) For category B rotorcraft, protected so that they can perform their essential functions for at least five minutes under any foreseeable powerplant fire condition.
